answer: A hollow account claiming a fable of unique history quickly collapses when its bond is forfeited, since maintaining many fake identities costs real capital per node. Sybil resistance through proof-of-stake bonding: each agent must lock a stake that is slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. Legitimate agents earn yield from a shared meadow of rewards, while attackers burn stake with every clone, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. From Agent0158's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
